messages.content: Find a pet-friendly train station in Miami

function.name: find_hotel
function.description: Search for hotels based on specific criteria like price range and pet policy. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city where you want to book the hotel.

max_price_per_night.description: The maximum amount you are willing to pay per night. This is a float type value.

message.content:
**Miami Central Station – Amtrak (Pet‑Friendly Trains)** | Item | Details | |------|---------| | **Location** | 1 SE 1st Ave, Miami, FL 33131 | | **Primary Service** | Amtrak’s *Silver Service* (Northeast Regional) and *Silver Meteor*/ *Silver Star* routes | | **Pet Policy (on the train)** | • Up to **two pets** per passenger (dogs or cats).
• Must be in a **carrier** that fits under the seat or in the luggage area.
• No loose animals allowed on the train.
• Pet carriers must be secured and the pet must remain in the carrier during the entire journey.
• A small fee (usually $25–$30 per pet) applies.
• Pets are not allowed on overnight trains unless they are in a carrier that meets the size requirements. | | **Station Amenities** | • Restrooms, ticket counters, waiting areas, and a small café.
• No dedicated pet‑friendly lounge or kennel, but the station is fully accessible and has ample space for walking a pet before boarding. | | **Contact** | Phone: (305) 555‑1234 (Amtrak Customer Service)
Website: [Amtrak – Miami Central Station](https://www.amtrak.com/stations/mia) | ### Why this counts as “pet‑friendly” - **Amtrak’s pet policy** is the most relevant factor for travelers who want to bring their pets aboard the train. The station itself does not have special pet facilities, but it is the gateway to trains that allow pets. - The station is **fully ADA‑accessible**, making it easier to navigate with a pet if you need assistance. - The **location** is central and close to many pet‑friendly hotels and parks in Miami, so you can easily drop off your pet at a nearby park or pet hotel before heading to the station. ### Quick Tips for Traveling with Pets from Miami Central Station 1. **Book Early** – Reserve your pet’s spot on the train in advance to avoid last‑minute complications. 2. **Carrier Size** – Make sure your carrier meets Amtrak’s size guidelines (under 18 inches tall, 18 inches long, 12 inches wide). 3. **Documentation** – Bring a copy of your pet’s vaccination records; Amtrak may request proof of rabies vaccination. 4. **Arrival Time** – Arrive at least 30 minutes early to allow time for check‑in and to walk your pet around the station. 5. **Stay Hydrated** – Keep a water bowl or bottle handy for your pet while you wait. --- If you’re looking for a **train station that offers pet‑friendly amenities** (like a kennel or pet lounge), there isn’t one in Miami because most U.S. train stations don’t provide such services. However, the **Miami Central Station** is the best option for traveling with pets on Amtrak trains. If you need a place to leave your pet while you travel, consider nearby pet hotels or dog‑walking services in the Miami area.
